name: Motus
description: Motus is a website template for physiotherapy practices, with a first visit told step by step beside a sticky photo, a price list with visit lengths, the team with their areas of work and short patient stories. A movement line running down the margin, deep teal with a coral accent and the Literata serif give the website a calm, caring character. Replace the copy, photos, practice details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a first visit card: price, three stages and booking
Movement line in the margin that follows the page
First visit step by step beside a sticky photo
Team portraits with areas of work and qualifications
Price list with visit length and thumbnails
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
